ShortDescription.Value: Not Enough Customers fix for cities with 100's of these icons.

Publish.LongDescription:
The problem was not merely too few shoppers. During the low-shopping part of the day, businesses were replenishing Service faster than the available customers could consume it.
The fix helps shops survive low traffic times of day by reducing total "service" production to better match the available customers. This is a more realistic of how businesses operate in real life. They are going to reduce total workers or send them on long breaks during low traffic times of the day.
This is adaptive and follows what vanilla already does to balance shopping economy: Strong recovery when badly out of balance, no intervention once healthy.
I still suggest making sure you don't have 100 vehicle shops and only 1 food shop. having a little of everything is still the best way to keep your city healthy.
